q: How long should I cool a burn?
text: Cool the burn under cool running water for twenty minutes [1][2]. Do not use ice or butter on the skin [1].

q: What is the dose of paracetamol for adults?
text: Adults usually take 500 mg to 1 g every four to six hours. The maximum is 4 g in 24 hours [1].

q: What does Dr. Smith recommend for a sprain?
text: Dr. Smith recommends rest, ice, compression and elevation for a sprain [1]. Avoid putting weight on the ankle for two days.
